result:
The rules could never match because they were not wrapped in `:global()`. The reports app uses CSS Modules, so the build renamed `.cds--date-picker`, `.cds--select`, `.cds--select-input` and `.cds--date-picker__input` to hashed local class names. Carbon's rendered markup carries the unhashed names, so the selectors matched nothing.

The four `width: 100%` rules sat under `.filterForm .formField` in `packages/esm-reports-app/src/components/reports.scss`. They were removed in commit `fbda030` (PR #358, "Remove inert Carbon CSS rules from reports app", merged 2026-10-01, ticket O3-5965). The PR describes the change as behavior-preserving dead-code removal, since the rules had no effect. No new tests were added, and the production build and existing suites passed. The same rules had been added earlier in `29fe116` (PR #67), but that commit is not the one that handled them.

Evidence, best first:
- `packages/esm-reports-app/src/components/reports.scss` (diff of `fbda030`): the removed lines are the `.cds--date-picker`, `.cds--select`, `.cds--select-input` and `.cds--date-picker__input` blocks inside `.formField`.
- PR #358 body: states the cause (no `:global()`, so CSS Modules rewrote the class names) and the outcome (no visual change).
- Pre-removal `reports.scss` lines 104–136: the `.filterForm` / `.formField` block that held the rules.
- `29fe116` (PR #67) originally added the `.cds--date-picker` rules to the same file.
